bad_request: The request could not be understood.
validation_failed: Some of the information provided is not valid.
method_not_allowed: That action is not available here.
not_found: We could not find what you asked for.
conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists.
phone_taken: This number is already verified on another Soirely account.
own_event_role: You cannot change your own role on an event.
last_owner: An organisation always has at least one owner.
owner_required: Only an owner of the organisation can do this.
grant_not_held: A role can only be given what you hold yourself.
already_linked: That is already linked to a Soirely account.
address_limit_reached: This account already has as many as it can hold.
address_not_verified: Verify it before making it primary.
last_verified_address: This is the one proof the account is yours.
provider_taken: That account is already linked to another Soirely account.
last_sign_in_method: Set a password or link another account before removing this one.
precondition_failed: Somebody else changed this since you opened it.
precondition_required: Send the version you are changing, as If-Match.
event_currency_in_use: The currency cannot change once amounts are recorded against this event.
event_state_invalid: The event’s state does not allow this.
event_concluded: The event has ended or been called off.
event_host_required: The event needs at least one host.
event_call_off_first: This event cannot be deleted until it is finished.
budget_line_currency_changed: The event’s currency has changed since this cost was removed.
vendor_already_quoted: That vendor already has a quote on this event, so this quote was not saved. To give a new price, revise that quote.
quote_unchanged: Change the amount or the date quoted to revise this quote. To change anything else, correct the quote instead.
payments_already_scheduled: Payments were added to this vendor’s schedule while you were filling this in, so none of yours were saved. Check the payments it has now before adding more.
vendor_owed: This vendor was not archived, because one or more events still have payments to it that are not paid or cancelled.
payment_already_paid: This has already been marked paid, so nothing has changed.
payment_cancelled: This payment has been cancelled, so it cannot be marked paid.
payer_limit: An event can have up to 20 payers.
payer_covers_costs: This payer covers costs. Choose who pays for them first.
plan_limit_reached: The plan’s limit has been reached.
event_capacity_reached: An event can have up to 10,000 people.
seating_plan_exists: This event already has a seating plan.
seating_section_limit: A plan can have up to 30 sections. Delete one to add another.
guest_already_listed: That name is already on the list.
guest_arrived: They have arrived, so they stay on the list.
staff_number_shared: That number is already on the roster.
staff_job_staffed: People are on this job’s shifts.
staff_job_worked: Someone has worked a shift in this job.
staff_shift_full: Every place on this shift is filled.
staff_works_as: This person works another job on this event.
staff_shift_overlap: This person is on another shift at that time.
staff_on_shifts: This person is on a shift, so their job cannot change.
dish_name_shared: There is already a dish with that name.
dish_in_use: An event uses this dish, so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
menu_course_limit: A menu can have at most {max} courses.
menu_course_picked: Guests have picked from this course.
menu_course_linked: This course is linked to a schedule item, so its served time is the item’s start. Change the item’s time on the Schedule page.
menu_dish_on_course: This dish is already on this course.
menu_same_one_dish: “Everyone gets the same” needs exactly one dish.
variant_limit: A dish can have at most {max} variants.
variant_last_everyone: This is the only variant for Everyone. Make another variant for Everyone first.
choice_limit: A dish can have at most 3 choices.
meal_picks_closed: Picks for this course have closed.
meal_pick_ruled_out: Their record rules this out. Confirm to pick it anyway.
reply_is_theirs: They replied themselves. Confirm to replace their reply.
guest_replied: They have replied, so they stay invited.
guest_not_marked_by_hand: Only an invitation marked by hand can be undone.
invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match.
invalid_refresh_token: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
oauth_token_invalid: That sign-in could not be checked, so nothing was changed. Try again, or sign in with your email and password.
reset_link_invalid: That reset link is not one Soirely sent.
reset_link_used: This link has already been used.
forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
permission_required: Your role does not include the permission this needs.
account_unverified: Verify your account to carry on.
profile_incomplete: Add a few details to carry on.
too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again.
verification_code_exhausted: That code no longer works. Send a new one to carry on.
internal_error: Something went wrong on our side.
assistant_busy: The assistant is busy. Please try again in a moment.
assistant_refused: The assistant would not answer that.
recovery_code_used: That recovery code has already been used.
two_factor_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app first.
recovery_nobody_to_approve: Nobody in your organisation can confirm this. Contact Soirely support.
recovery_request_invalid: That request isn’t open any more. Start again from the sign-in code screen.
recovery_request_proved: This request is already waiting for an answer.
recovery_request_replaced: A newer request was started on another device.
already_a_member: That person is already a member of this organisation.
email_taken: That email address already has a Soirely account. Sign in with it to accept the invitation.
invitation_not_found: We could not find that invitation. Check the link in the email.
invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.
invitation_accepted: This invitation has already been accepted.
invitation_not_yours: This invitation is for a different email address.
organisation_deleted: This organisation no longer exists, so the invitation cannot be accepted.
export_not_ready: This export is not ready yet.
export_used: This export has already been downloaded.
provider_kept_by_rule: Your organisation signs in with Google or Apple only, so your last one stays linked.
oauth_only: This organisation signs in with Google or Apple only.
sso_sign_in_required: This organisation signs you in through its identity provider.
oauth_only_unlinked: No Google or Apple account is linked.
organisation_two_factor_required: This organisation asks for two-factor first.
two_factor_kept_by_rule: Your organisation requires two-factor, so you cannot turn it off.
two_factor_last_factor: This is your last two-factor method. Turn off two-factor to remove it.
passkey_limit: You have 10 passkeys, the most an account can hold. Remove one to add another.
session_timed_out: Signed out after a time without use.
join_offer_unavailable: You cannot ask to join that organisation. Start your own, or ask somebody there to invite you.
restore_needs_address: Their access cannot be restored until they have a verified address at the company domain again.
request_link_dead: This link does not work any more. Ask the organisation for a new one.
join_request_waiting: Your request to join is already waiting for an answer.
join_request_cooling_off: You cannot ask to join this organisation again yet.
join_request_answered: This request has already been answered, or was removed.
owner_claim_address: To become the owner, your main address must be at the organisation’s domain.
owner_claim_managed: That domain is managed by another organisation. Contact Soirely support.
domain_managed: Your address is managed by an organisation, so you can only be a member there.
owner_claim_open: Somebody is already becoming the owner of this organisation.
owner_claim_closed: Ownership has to be restored by Soirely support.
owner_claim_unavailable: This organisation has an active owner.
owner_claim_own: You cannot stop your own claim.
seating_items_outside: Something in the room would sit outside it.
seating_table_short: That table has too few free seats for the party.
seating_guest_not_waiting: This guest is not waiting for a seat.
schedule_item_limit: This schedule has {max} items, the most an event can hold. Delete one to add another.
item_not_started: This item has not started yet, so it cannot be done.
track_busy: Another item on this track is on. Finish it first.
idempotency_key_required: Send an Idempotency-Key with each press.
idempotency_key_reused: This Idempotency-Key was sent with a different press.
plan_required: The organisation’s plan does not include this.
email_domain_taken: Another organisation has already proved this domain.
sso_untested: Single sign-on has not been tested.
door_code_invalid: That code does not work. Check it with whoever gave it to you.
menu_is_default: This is part of the course’s default. Choose another default first.
menu_default_move: Changing the default moves the guests given it. Confirm to change it.
menu_change_asks: This change asks guests to pick again. Confirm to change it.
menu_event_over: This event’s date has passed, so its menu can’t change. Nothing was changed.
phone_alternative: This is an alternative number on a Soirely account, so it cannot sign you in.
invitation_needs_email: Add the invitation’s email address to your account and verify it, then accept the invitation.
plan_sold_by_contract: This plan is sold by contract, not through checkout. Contact Soirely to arrange it.
plan_not_priced: This plan has no price in your billing currency.
nothing_paid_through_provider: There is no payment method to update until a plan is paid for.
audience_name_taken: That name is already used by a saved audience.
audiences_full: This event has as many saved audiences as it can have.
table_not_yours: This table is in somebody else’s section. Ask them or the floor lead.
level_not_allowed_for_code: A join code cannot let people run the floor. Give Can run the floor to one person, with their own link from the roster.
tray_not_yours: This tray is {name}’s. Ask them or the floor lead.
plate_stage_invalid: This plate cannot take that step from where it is now.
plate_empty: A plate with nothing on it is not taken to a guest. Take it off the tray instead.
table_nothing_to_serve: There is nothing to put on a tray for this table yet.
tray_check_incomplete: Mark every item On, or Not on and Bring after, before checking the tray.
undo_expired: It is more than 2 minutes since that step, so it cannot be undone.
service_changed: Someone else changed this while you were offline. Nothing was saved.
expected_required: Send what the tap saw with each service step.
